review.posthog_relevance: Changes warehouse query semantics and frontend parsing for Page Performance, including HogQL bucketing, shared-axis merging, and conversion metric definitions, potentially affecting warehouse compatibility and result interpretation.
review.reason: This chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement. P1.F11.H4 and P1.F11.H8 show backend query changes (HogQL bucketing, GROUPING SETS) and frontend TypeScript interfaces for parsing warehouse responses, establishing typed response handling and shared-axis merging. P1.F11.H6 changes warehouse query semantics for shared metrics. P1.F11.H18 unifies request handling
review.uncertainty: Tier 3 requires broader systemic risk reduction or broader capability demonstrated across components, which cannot be established without the complete PR and its other hunks. Tier 1 is too low for backend query and shared-axis implementation. The score relies on the supplied hunks establishing a bounded implementation, while unverified outcomes and complete PR context remain absent

observations.behavior: Replaces inline conditional page count formatting with a call to pluralize; refactors request cancellation and error handling; unifies the abort-signal and request-creation pattern; changes the shape of the success payload from a flat object to an object with a totals and a merged series; removes the previous hogql query construction and the previous error-handling path.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk changes the page performance overview and candidate loading behavior in the web analytics frontend. It replaces a direct conditional string formatting with a helper, and unifies the request cancellation and error handling. The payload shape change could affect downstream consumers of the success action, while the cancellation and error handling changes could affect the UX
